data.text: CAYLEY ROOMS: EVERY GROUP OF ORDER 1 TO 20. A GATE FOR EACH ELEMENT, ONE OPEN. A LEVER FOR EACH GENERATOR MOVES THE OPENING FROM G TO G TIMES IT
PORTAL: BACK TO THE GROUPS
RESET: THE CAYLEY ROOMS BACK AS NEW, TO PLAY AGAIN
1: TRIVIAL GROUP OF ORDER 1, GAP SMALLGROUP (1,1).1 GATE, NO LEVER. IT COMMUTES.
ONE GATE, ALWAYS OPEN: THE GROUP OF ONE ELEMENT. NO LEVER, NOTHING TO DO
DEBUG: THE TRIVIAL GROUP, NO TARGET
Z2: CYCLIC GROUP OF ORDER 2, GAP SMALLGROUP (2,1).2 GATES, 1 LEVER: A OF ORDER 2. IT COMMUTES.
ONE GATE IS OPEN. EACH LEVER MOVES THE OPEN GATE ALONG ITS OWN PATH. OPEN THE GATE WITH THE DIAMOND: THE RING IS WHERE IT BEGAN
